title: Hey if
author: Advanced_Invite9435
selftext:
First post



I have been using CC to clean up and put to use 10+ years of 3d models I have created. It's created loads of scripts and kitbashes out of just a few models so I now a possess a much broader range of assets to use.

  
I am making a big open world game set in a city.

  
I was thinking that if many of us using CC could set up a github which is a library for CC agents to come and nab the good ideas.



For example I have been making spline based plants and trees, this week with seasonal variations. (My heart bleeds for the owners of Speedtree), i'd be happy to "push" the script to a library so other CC agents could put it to use or add to it.

  
That we can pad out our tokens.
